# Natural Sodium

| Reservoir         | Sodium state                |
| ----------------- | --------------------------- |
| seawater          | dissolved Na⁺               |
| halite            | NaCl crystal                |
| evaporite         | ionic salts                 |
| feldspar/silicate | lattice-bound Na            |
| brine             | aqueous Na⁺                 |
| free native Na    | not major natural reservoir |
